newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start lower, Wall St, rate worries weigh.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start lower, Wall St, rate worries weigh.

text.p: UK shares opened sharply lower on Thursday with investor confidence hit by Wall Street's 51-point decline overnight as well as growing concern that both UK and U.S. interest rates may have to rise in the near-term, dealers said.
"When Wall Street falls 50 points it's bound to knock the wind out of our sails," one senior dealer said. "But we shouldn't see any panic selling -- just volatility."
The FTSE 100 index was down 27.3 points by 0835 GMT while the March FTSE 100 futures contract eased 21.0 at 4,065. On Wednesday, the Dow industrials fell 51.18 at 6,549.48.
